help.faqSubtitle: Everything you might want to know about GEDO.AI

items.a: GEDO.AI is an AI-Native personal assistant and digital twin platform. Through natural conversation, it automatically manages your memories, plans goals, tracks tasks, and evolves with you to become an intelligent companion that truly understands you.

items.q: How is it different from regular AI chatbots?
items.a: GEDO.AI has long-term memory, automatic goal decomposition, independent personality, and proactive care. It doesn't just answer questions — it's a digital twin that continuously learns about you and grows with you.

items.q: Do I need any configuration to start?
items.a: No. Sign in and you can start chatting with your AI companion right away — no extra setup needed.

items.q: Can I bring in my chats from other AI apps?
items.a: Yes. Memory's Sources hub imports chat exports from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Kimi, plus PDF, Word, web links and pasted text. The AI extracts candidate memories first, and nothing is saved until you confirm each one — the original sources stay in your account, viewable and deletable anytime.

items.q: What is the personal Twin model?
items.a: An upcoming Ultra capability: after you grant a separate training consent, we train a model that's yours alone — on samples you approved, only on GEDO's own infrastructure. Training data is never sent to third-party AI providers. You can revoke consent anytime, and revoking physically deletes both the data and the model.

MCP is the AI industry's open connection protocol. You can plug external tools into your companion from Settings and call them in chat or task automations; your digital persona also exposes a public MCP endpoint, so any MCP-enabled AI can talk to the persona you chose to publish. The personal memory endpoint (Pro and up) is live too: generate a personal access token under Settings → Developer/Access and search your own Gedo memory from Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients — output is redacted, AI-excluded memories never leave, and every token is revocable with an audit log.
Your data is stored per-user on cloud servers and encrypted in transit over HTTPS. You can export or permanently delete all of it at any time.

items.q: Will my conversations be used for training?
items.a: Not by default — and never for general-purpose models. The only exceptions are ones you switch on yourself: Twin model training (Ultra, coming soon) and "Help improve GEDO" (coming soon) each require separate consent, run only on GEDO's own infrastructure, and can be revoked anytime — revoking physically deletes the data.

items.q: How do I delete my data?
items.a: In the Settings page, you can export or delete all your data with one click, including memories, goals, and conversation history. Deletion is permanent.

items.q: Is it safe to plug in external tools, or take my memory to another AI?
items.a: You control both directions. Inbound: you add each external tool yourself, can remove it anytime, and every call is visible in the conversation. Outbound: public endpoints only expose what you explicitly chose to publish; when you carry your memory into a third-party AI, that content flows to a provider you picked — that's you exercising data sovereignty, and Gedo never makes that call for you.
Click "Get Started Free" to sign up — you can start chatting in under 2 minutes, with no extra configuration.
A free tier with basic quota is available. Pro and Ultra unlock more quota, long-term memory and advanced features.
The web app runs in all modern browsers and is live in beta today; an iOS client is in invite-only beta. iOS and Android launch soon, with iPad and desktop (macOS / Windows) rolling out after.

items.q: Can I use GEDO across multiple devices?
items.a: Yes. Your account syncs across devices — memories and goals stay consistent everywhere you sign in.

items.q: How do I migrate my data?
items.a: Export all your data via the Settings page in a standard format and import it into a new device or account to restore it.

items.q: What happens to my data if I delete my account?
items.a: After account deletion, we permanently remove all your data within 30 days with no backups retained.

faqs.q: Are there limits on the free plan?
faqs.a: Free lets you manage core goals, tasks and memory with a starter smart quota — enough to experience the essentials. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited goals and memory, a generous smart quota, and your own digital persona.

faqs.q: What's the difference between smart quota and persona quota?
faqs.a: Smart quota powers your everyday AI — chat, planning, memory and image understanding. Persona quota is separate and only powers your public digital persona's replies to visitors. The two are independent and never draw from each other; you can check your live usage anytime in the Account Center.

faqs.q: What do Pro and Ultra include?
faqs.a: Pro unlocks the full personal AI assistant — unlimited goals and memory with a generous smart quota — and lets you publish your own digital persona with a trial persona quota. Ultra adds a richer smart quota, a fuller persona quota for everyday use, and will include the Twin personal model when it launches.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund on annual billing?
faqs.a: For purchases made on the web (card via Stripe): full refund within 14 days; after 14 days, prorated refund based on remaining months. Purchases made through the Apple App Store or Google Play are refunded by the platform under its own policy — request them directly from Apple or Google.
Absolutely. After cancellation, Pro features remain active until the end of your billing cycle, then auto-downgrade to Free.

faqs.q: Can I subscribe to Pro and Ultra at the same time? How do I switch plans?
faqs.a: Only one paid tier is active at a time. To switch plans (including Pro to Ultra), cancel your current subscription in the billing portal and subscribe again after the billing period ends—we do not upgrade or change price mid-subscription. If multiple legacy subscriptions exist, we keep the higher tier and cancel the rest.

faqs.q: Is pricing the same on iOS, Android and the web?
faqs.a: Yes — the same plans at the same prices everywhere. Subscribe in the mobile app (billed through the App Store or Google Play) or on the web (card via Stripe). One subscription works across all your devices; manage or cancel it on the platform where you purchased.

security.title: Security & Privacy Statement
security.subtitle: How GEDO.AI collects, uses, stores and protects your information, the control you keep over your data, and where our responsibility begins and ends during the beta.
intro: At Gedo, privacy isn’t a feature bolted on afterwards — it’s a design premise. We believe the memories, goals and conversations you record belong to you; our job is to keep them safe and let you view, export and delete them at any time.

This statement applies to the GEDO.AI website, app and related services (the “Service”). The Service is currently in invite-only beta, and some security capabilities are still being built. We choose to describe the real state of things here rather than make promises we can’t keep.

p: The Service is operated by GEDO PTE. LTD., a technology company registered in Singapore (“we”, “us”, or “GEDO”), which acts as the controller of your personal data.

This statement covers how we collect, use, store, share and delete personal data when you use the Service. It is a product-level statement; where the law requires it, we will separately provide a formal Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
We follow a principle of minimal collection — gathering only what the Service needs to work:
list: Account information: the email, display name and avatar you register with, plus your membership and subscription status.
Content you create or import: memories, goals, plans, tasks, conversations, and the chat exports, documents and web content you bring in via Sources — the heart of the Service, all provided by you.
Necessary technical data: login state, basic device and browser information, and limited operational logs needed to run and secure the Service.
We do not quietly collect your contacts, location history or cross-site behavioural profiles unrelated to the product.

p: We use the information above only to:
list: Provide and maintain the core Service — memory storage and recall, goal planning and AI conversation.
Personalise recall, insights and suggestions based on your own data.
With your separate, explicit consent — and only then — train your personal twin model or improve GEDO's own models. Both are off by default; see “Model training & your consent” below.
Keep your account and data secure, troubleshoot issues, and prevent abuse and fraud.
Communicate product updates and important notices, where you have agreed to receive them.
We do not use your personal content for advertising, and we do not sell or rent it to third parties for marketing.

p: The Service’s conversations and some intelligent features rely on large language models. To provide them, your conversation content and related context — including content queued for memory extraction and source imports — are sent, at the moment you make a request, to third-party model providers (such as Anthropic and OpenAI) for inference, and the results are returned to you.

These providers act as our subprocessors and process the data only on our instructions to complete that request. Under their developer-facing terms, content submitted via their APIs is not used to train their general-purpose models by default.

Vector embeddings for semantic search are computed within our own environment, and some extraction tasks run there first, falling back to third-party providers only when needed. We continuously assess each provider’s security and compliance, and reserve the right to change providers when needed.

By default, nothing you create is ever used to train models — that is the factory setting, and we will not change it for you. The following two capabilities are optional, off by default, independent of each other, and revocable at any time:
list: Twin model training (coming soon): after you sign a separate training consent, we train a personal twin model on the samples you approved — processed only on GEDO’s own infrastructure, never sent to third-party AI providers, and never merged into any general-purpose model.
Help improve GEDO (coming soon): when enabled, your conversations may be used to compare, evaluate and improve GEDO’s own models — on GEDO’s own servers. You can switch it off at any time.
Revoke = physical deletion: withdraw your training consent at any time, and the corresponding training data and any trained personal model are physically deleted, beyond recovery.
sections.note: In short: no consent, no training; with consent, only on our own compute; change your mind, and it’s gone for good.

p: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including:
list: Encryption in transit: all traffic between you and the Service is encrypted over HTTPS/TLS.
Per-user storage: during the beta, your data is stored per-user in the cloud and isolated behind account authentication.
Access control: only authorised services access data, within the scope required to deliver a feature; internal access follows the principle of least privilege.

An honest note on encryption at rest: at-rest encryption of storage media and independent key management are still planned and not yet fully enabled in the beta. We won’t dress this up with phrases like “military-grade encryption”.
sections.note: No system can be perfectly secure. We keep hardening our security, and we describe today’s limits honestly in the Disclaimer below.

p: Your data is yours to command. The Service gives you these self-service controls, available at any time:
list: One-click export: export your memories, goals and conversations as a portable .gmp memory pack, to take anywhere.
Hard delete: delete any single memory, or wipe your entire account. We don’t soft-delete, and we keep no hidden backups afterwards.
Pause memory: pause long-term memory with one switch; the AI immediately stops recalling and stops learning from new conversations.
Per-item AI exclusion: mark any single memory invisible to the AI — you decide what it gets to see.
Confirm before saving: candidate memories the AI extracts from conversations or imported sources are only written to your memory after you confirm each one.

Outbound access is your call: what your digital persona exposes, and the access tokens for your personal memory endpoint (scoped, revocable, audit-logged), stay fully under your control. Carrying your memory into a third-party AI is your act of data sovereignty — we never share it on our own.

p: While you use the Service, we retain the content you create so we can keep serving you. When you delete a piece of data or close your account, that data is hard-deleted.

Because of operational logs and routine backup cycles, incidental technical copies may briefly remain in rolling logs and are cleared automatically on their cycle; we won’t use this as an excuse to retain your deleted personal content long-term.
Some lines are fixed from day one:
list: We will never sell or rent your personal data.
We will never use your private content to train our own or any third party’s general-purpose models.
We will never run hidden behavioural surveillance or cross-site tracking beyond the product.
We will never make privacy-surrendering choices for you “on by default”.
We will never train any model on your content without your separate consent — including your own twin model.

p: We use necessary cookies and browser local storage to keep you signed in, remember interface preferences (such as language and theme) and maintain basic security. We do not use third-party marketing cookies for cross-site ad tracking. You can clear this data in your browser settings, though it may affect sign-in and some features.
GEDO is registered in Singapore and serves users worldwide, so your data may be stored or processed outside your region (including where our cloud and model providers operate).

By design, we align with the core principles of GDPR, CCPA and other major privacy frameworks — notice, minimisation, access, portability and deletion. If the law in your region grants you rights to access, correct, export or delete your personal data, you can exercise them via the contact below.

The Service is not directed to children under 14. If you are under 18, please use it with the consent and guidance of a parent or guardian. If we learn we have collected a child’s personal information without guardian consent, we will delete it promptly.

As the product evolves and our security matures, we may update this statement from time to time. Material changes will be reflected on this page, with the “Last updated” date at the top. Continuing to use the Service means you are aware of the updated content.
If you have any questions about this statement, or wish to exercise your data rights — access, export, correction or deletion — please reach us:
list: Privacy & data requests: support@gedo.ai
General enquiries: info@gedo.ai
Company address: 160 Robinson Road, #14-04, Singapore Business Federation Center, Singapore 068914

p: The Service is currently in invite-only beta and is provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis. We make reasonable efforts to keep it available and secure, but we do not guarantee it will be uninterrupted, error-free or absolutely secure.

As noted above, at-rest encryption, independent key management, comprehensive auditing and finer-grained retention policies are still being built. Until these are fully in place, please use your own judgement before entering highly sensitive information (such as ID documents, bank card numbers or other people’s private data).

Keeping your account credentials safe is your responsibility. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for exposure resulting from your own sharing, public publishing (for example, making a digital persona public) or a third party obtaining your credentials without authorisation.

The Service relies on third-party infrastructure and model providers whose own terms and privacy policies are independent of this statement. For issues caused by third parties, we will help address them but will not assume liability beyond our own fault.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential losses arising from your use of, or inability to use, the Service. Nothing here excludes or limits liability that cannot be excluded under applicable law. Where this statement conflicts with mandatory law in your region, that law prevails.
This is a product-level security and privacy statement and does not constitute legal advice. At general availability we will provide a legally binding Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

capabilities.title: More than an AI assistant — a system that grows you.
capabilities.desc: It gets to know you, turns a vague direction into a clear next step, and stays with you all the way.

cards.title: Memory
cards.subtitle: The more you use it, the more it knows you
cards.desc: A Life Flower maps your eight life areas, and a Codex gives the people and things around you their own card. The AI pulls key facts and waits for your OK before saving — knowing you is the precondition for everything else.

cards.title: Planner
cards.subtitle: Turns being lost into a clear next step
cards.desc: It reads your energy curve, past retros and today's state, then breaks a vague direction into small, doable steps. It helps you think clearly and decide — and leaves the call to you.

cards.title: Companion
cards.subtitle: Proactive · Grows with you · Transparent
cards.desc: It checks in, reflects, breaks down goals, calls tools. Every reply shows the tool calls and a context canvas — not a black box, but a companion whose thinking you can see.

memoryArch.headline: Four-layer memorySo the AI actually remembers you
memoryArch.intro: Modelled on human memory. Identity and semantics live in the context window; working memory carries the current session; episodic stays archived but retrievable; a nightly pass distils new experience back into long-term semantics. The people, things and events around you each get a codex card — anchors that tie the fragments together.

bullets.v: Identity + eight life areas · compressed into context
Focus, open items, current task · continuity across turns
Events / state / decisions archived · retrieved on demand
People / things / places / events as anchors · mention one, recall what's linked
Nightly AI pass: pattern extraction, write-back to profile

openPowers.title: New in this release: more open, still yours
openPowers.desc: Import your past, mint a model of your own, plug tools in, take your memory anywhere — every step opt-in, every step reversible.

cards.title: Memory sources
cards.subtitle: Bring your past in, all at once
cards.desc: Import chat exports from ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Kimi, plus PDF, Word, web links and pasted text. The AI proposes candidate memories; nothing is saved until you confirm it — sources stay traceable and deletable.

cards.title: Your own model
cards.subtitle: Your voice, your own model
cards.desc: With a separate, revocable consent, we train a personal twin model on the samples you approve — only on GEDO's own infrastructure, never sent to third-party AI providers. Revoking physically deletes the data and the model. Ultra only.

cards.title: Plug tools in
cards.subtitle: Give your companion real tools
cards.desc: Connect external tools and services over the open MCP protocol: call them right in chat, or let task automations trigger them on schedule. One protocol, a whole ecosystem.

cards.title: Take it anywhere
cards.subtitle: Your persona and memory, in any AI
cards.desc: Your public digital persona now speaks MCP — any MCP-enabled AI can talk to it. And with a personal access token (Pro and up), you can carry your Gedo memory into Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client you choose.
